highlights: Operate one of the largest fleets of new, spacious Cameron Balloons in Minnesota
checkin: What you need to know before scheduling and purchasing certificates: - Hot Air Ballooning is very weather dependent. The wind, cloud cover, temperature, and precipitation levels all have to align for us to fly safely. We do not fly if the wind speed is over ten miles an hour anywhere under four thousand feet. Because of these conditions, we cancel over 75% of our scheduled flights.
cancellation: All flights, certificates and bookings are nonrefundable, cannot be combined, and are fully transferable (so hold on tight... whoever holds the certificate can use it... treat it as you would cash).

quotes.author: Lori S -Tripadivosr
quotes.text: Had a marvelous balloon ride! The staff was knowledgeable, professional, friendly and efficient. Our private flight took us over the St Croix River, over to Hudson and we gently landed in a gorgeous wooded neighborhood. After we toasted the flight with champagne. It was fun to see the region from high above. I’m afraid of heights but had no problem feeling safe with Pete, our pilot, who had 28 years of experience!

quotes.author: Rhonda B -Tripadvisor
quotes.text: This was a great experience! We felt very welcome from the minute we drove into the parking lot. Easy check-in. We got to watch them inflate the balloons which was very interesting. It was so incredible up in the air. I couldn't believe how smoothly the balloon just glided through the air. Very calm and serene! Our captain was great and very knowledgeable.

quotes.author: Diane P -Tripadvisor
quotes.text: Absolutely fabulous experience! We were able to see the balloons being fully assembled and filled - really a cool experience. The staff was top-notch! The views were spectacular of the St. Croix Valley. Once we landed, staff came out of nowhere to quickly disassemble and ferry us back to the starting point. It was all very well done.

quotes.author: Kz K -Tripadvisor
quotes.text: Wonderful experience. Celebrated our 30th wedding anniversary. Signed up for the larger group option and highly recommended it. Wonderful camaraderie as you meet new people. Our pilot was Steve and he was knowledgeable and a delight. Due to their emphasis on safety you may need to reschedule until the weather is perfect.

quotes.author: Jena -Tripadvisor
quotes.text: This was an awesome adventure and definitely worth the wait! The crew team was very helpful. Let us know what balloon we were in and who our pilot was. They offered to take our pictures before going up. Once in the air, scenery is beautiful and unforgettable. From start to finish the whole experience was amazing!
